name: japan-pet-quarantine
description: Free checker for bringing a dog or cat into Japan, taking it out, or leaving and coming back: earliest arrival (180 days after the rabies antibody blood draw), 40-day AQS notice, 10-day vet-check window, 14-day export application (mandatory for dogs and rabbits from 2027-01-01), detention days if early. Keyless JSON API + MCP.
